Container.Name: CachePanel
Container.Overview:
CachePanel is a self-hosted, open-source web dashboard for a LanCache setup. It replaces the terminal-only Steam/Battle.net/Epic prefill tool selection and DeveLanCacheUI with one modern interface: cache hit/miss dashboard with per-service and per-client stats, Steam library browsing via the Steam Web API (with cover art), a Battle.net/Epic product picker, per-service prefill scheduling, live prefill log streaming, DNS/cache-reachability diagnostics, cache corruption scanning, Prometheus metrics, and optional Discord notifications.
Requires an existing LanCache setup (lancache + lancache-dns) and the tpill90 SteamPrefill/BattleNetPrefill/EpicPrefill containers already running -- CachePanel is a UI/controller for those, not a replacement for them. It needs access to their container config directories (to write game selections) and to the Docker socket (to trigger prefill runs and read container status).
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: lancache steam battlenet epic prefill cache dashboard gameserver
Container.Requires: An existing LanCache (lancache + lancache-dns) setup, plus the tpill90 SteamPrefill/BattleNetPrefill/EpicPrefill containers already deployed.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the CachePanel web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: CachePanel's own data: encrypted settings, prefill run history, schedule, panel login.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Lets CachePanel trigger prefill runs and read lancache/lancache-dns/prefill container status. Read-only.

Config.Name: LanCache Logs
Config.Description: Path to your LanCache access logs (same volume your lancache container writes logs to). Read-only.

Config.Name: Steam Prefill Config
Config.Description: Same host path your steam-prefill container uses for its config -- CachePanel writes the selected-games list here.

Config.Name: Battle.net Prefill Config
Config.Description: Same host path your battlenet-prefill container uses for its config.

Config.Name: Epic Prefill Config
Config.Description: Same host path your epic-prefill container uses for its config.

Config.Name: LANCACHE_IP
Config.Description: LAN IP of the machine running lancache + lancache-dns (often this same host). Leave blank to skip the DNS/reachability diagnostics checks.

Config.Name: STEAM_PREFILL_CONTAINER
Config.Description: Container name of your steam-prefill container, if not the default.

Config.Name: BATTLENET_PREFILL_CONTAINER
Config.Description: Container name of your battlenet-prefill container, if not the default.

Config.Name: EPIC_PREFILL_CONTAINER
Config.Description: Container name of your epic-prefill container, if not the default.
